subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about driving bound-policy volume for {Brand} in the states where you write the line. The one point worth repeating: we optimize to the completed policy purchase and read it back through carrier-side bind confirmation, held through the free-look and first-payment window, so you pay only for issued policies that survive the chargeback window. At scale that runs around 1,200 completed policy purchases a day. If it helps, I can pull the state-level bind-rate view for your licensed footprint. Worth a quick look?
angle: warm bump, restate completed-policy-purchase bind proof
illustrative_flags: 1,200 completed policy purchases a day (MobUpps, illustrative)
